question: What maternal identity is traditionally ascribed to the goddess in īkāra?
premises: In īkāra is the goddess Mātṛkā
She is remembered as mother of the worlds
inference: The goddess in īkāra is traditionally known as Mātṛkā, mother of the worlds.
plain_english: In īkāra is the goddess Mātṛkā, remembered as the mother of the worlds.
